about: Usual area codes for each county, by state. Codes are listed with the main one first and overlays after their base code. Built from Wikipedia's area-code articles, WorldAtlas and zip-codes.com county lists, checked town by town where counties are split. To add a state, add it under 'states' with every county's codes; per-state notes explain split or uncertain counties.

IN.source: Wikipedia: Area code 219 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_code_219 ; Area codes 317 and 463 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_317_and_463 ; List of Indiana area codes https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Indiana_area_codes ; town infoboxes (e.g. Earl Park, Medaryville, San Pierre, Silver Lake, Flora, Macy, Monon, Brookston, LaFontaine, Dunkirk, Atlanta, Edinburgh, Oldenburg, Morristown, Martinsville, Mooresville, Lebanon, Zionsville, Ingalls, North Salem, Wilkinson, Rosedale, Ligonier); WorldAtlas https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/in/area-code-765.html (and -260, -574, -317, -812); zip-codes.com https://www.zip-codes.com/area-code/area-code-765.asp (and -219, -260, -317, -574, -812, -930); town hall phone numbers bentoncounty.in.gov/earl-park, morgantown.in.gov

counties.Benton: Mostly 765 (Fowler, Oxford); Earl Park exchange is 219 (219-474).
counties.Boone: Zionsville/Whitestown are 317/463 (most population); Lebanon, Thorntown, Jamestown are 765.
counties.Carroll: Delphi/Burlington 765; Flora and Camden exchanges are 574.
counties.Cass: All 574 (Logansport, Galveston, Royal Center). zip-codes.com also lists Cass under 765 via ZIP overlap; treated as negligible.
counties.Franklin: Brookville/Laurel/Metamora 765; Oldenburg and the Batesville-area SE corner are 812.
counties.Hamilton: Almost all 317/463; Atlanta exchange (far north) is 765.
counties.Hancock: Almost all 317/463 (Greenfield, Fortville, New Palestine); Wilkinson/Shirley area is 765.
counties.Hendricks: Almost all 317/463; North Salem area (NW corner) is 765.
counties.LaPorte: All 219 per sources checked (incl. Kingsford Heights). WorldAtlas/zip-codes.com also list LaPorte under 574, likely a ZIP spillover near New Carlisle; consider adding 574 if leads show it.
counties.Madison: Mostly 765 (Anderson, Elwood, Pendleton); Ingalls area (SW) is 317.
counties.Morgan: Split roughly evenly: Martinsville and south/west 765; Mooresville/Monrovia (NE) 317/463; Morgantown (SE) 812. Main-code order is uncertain.
counties.Noble: All 260 (Ligonier confirmed 260). WorldAtlas lists Noble under 574 too; likely a ZIP spillover.
counties.Parke: All 765 (Rockville, Rosedale). WorldAtlas lists Parke under 812; possible sliver near Vigo line.
counties.Randolph: All 765. zip-codes.com lists Randolph under 260 too (ZIP overlap near Jay line).
counties.Union: All 765 (Liberty). zip-codes.com lists Union under 812 too (ZIP overlap).
counties.Vigo: Terre Haute 812/930. WorldAtlas lists Vigo under 765 too; possible sliver along the Parke/Clay line.
counties.White: Monticello/Burnettsville 574; Monon, Reynolds, Wolcott, Chalmers 219; Brookston 765.
counties.Marion: 463 and 930 are all-services overlays of 317 and 812; they apply wherever 317/812 do.

MI.source: Wikipedia: List of Michigan area codes https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Michigan_area_codes ; Area code 616 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_code_616 ; Area code 734 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_code_734 ; Area codes 248 and 947 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_248_and_947 ; Area code 810 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_code_810 ; Area code 586 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_code_586 ; Area codes 313 and 679 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_313_and_679 ; Area code 906 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_code_906 ; Area code 269/517/989/231 articles (city lists only). WorldAtlas county lists: https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/mi/area-code-989.html , https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/mi/area-code-231.html , https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/mi/area-code-517.html , https://worldatlas.com/na/us/mi/area-code-810.html ; zip-codes.com per-county area-code lists, e.g. https://www.zip-codes.com/county/MI-BARRY.asp (ZIP-based, so cross-border ZIPs give spurious slivers; used as a cross-check only). Rate-centre-level assignments for split counties come from knowledge of individual exchanges and were not checked against NANPA rate-centre data.

counties.Mackinac: 906 for the county; Bois Blanc Township (Bois Blanc Island) is served from Cheboygan on 231 (per Wikipedia 'Area code 906').
counties.Muskegon: Mostly 231; Wikipedia lists parts of Muskegon County in 616 (e.g. Casnovia/Ravenna-area rate centres near the Kent/Ottawa line).
counties.Mecosta: Mostly 231 (Big Rapids, Morley, Stanwood); eastern part (e.g. Remus, Barryton) is 989.
counties.Clinton: 989 for St. Johns, Ovid, Elsie, Fowler, Westphalia; 517 for DeWitt, Bath and the Lansing/Grand Ledge fringe. Roughly even split; 989 covers more area.
counties.Shiawassee: 989 for Owosso/Corunna/Durand; 517 for Laingsburg, Perry, Morrice; 810 for the Byron area in the southeast.
counties.Montcalm: Three-way split: 989 for Stanton, Edmore, Lakeview, Carson City, Sheridan; 616 for Greenville; 231 for Howard City. 989 has the most area, but Greenville is the largest city.
counties.Ionia: 616 for Ionia, Belding, Lake Odessa, Saranac; 517 for Portland; 989 for the northeast corner (Muir/Lyons/Pewamo area).
counties.Kent: 616 for the whole county per Wikipedia. zip-codes.com also lists 269 (cross-border ZIPs in the south) and worldatlas lists 231 (the northern edge); treat these as slivers at most.
counties.Ottawa: 616 for the whole county per Wikipedia. zip-codes.com also lists 231 through a cross-border ZIP in the north; a sliver at most.
counties.Allegan: Mostly 269 (Allegan, Otsego, Plainwell, Wayland); the northern townships near Holland/Dorr are 616.
counties.Barry: Mostly 269 (Hastings, Delton); the north (Middleville, Freeport) is 616; Nashville/Woodland in the east is 517.
counties.Calhoun: 269 for Battle Creek and Marshall; 517 for Albion, Homer, Tekonsha.
counties.Livingston: 810 for Brighton/Hartland; 517 for Howell/Fowlerville; 734 for Pinckney (Pinckney is listed in Wikipedia 'Area code 734'). 810 and 517 are close in size.
counties.Lenawee: 517 per Wikipedia. zip-codes.com also lists 734 through a cross-border ZIP near Manchester/Washtenaw; a sliver at most.
counties.Genesee: Wikipedia says all of Genesee County is 810. zip-codes.com also lists 248 and 989 through cross-border ZIPs; slivers at most.
counties.Lapeer: Wikipedia says all of Lapeer County is 810. worldatlas/zip-codes.com also list 989 (northern edge); a sliver at most.
counties.St. Clair: 810 (Port Huron). The Wikipedia 810 article says only 'portions' of St. Clair County are 810. The southwest corner (Ira Twp/Anchorville/Fair Haven) may be in 586; unverified, and zip-codes.com lists only 810.
counties.Sanilac: Mostly 810 (Sandusky, Croswell, Brown City); the northwest (Marlette area) is 989.
counties.Oakland: 248 with its 947 overlay for nearly the whole county; some north Oakland rate centres are 810 (parts of Holly, Groveland, Brandon, Addison, Oxford per Wikipedia 'Area code 810'). zip-codes.com also lists 313/586/734 through cross-border ZIPs; those are not added.
counties.Macomb: 586 for the county; the northern rate centres (e.g. Memphis) are 810; a very small part of Shelby Twp is 248. zip-codes.com lists 586 and 810.
counties.Wayne: 313 with its 679 overlay (679 added 2025) for Detroit and the inner suburbs; 734 for the western and Downriver areas (Livonia, Canton, Plymouth, Westland, Taylor, Romulus); 248/947 for parts of Livonia and Northville.
counties.Osceola: 231 per Wikipedia and worldatlas. zip-codes.com also lists 989 through a cross-border ZIP on the east edge; a sliver at most.
counties.Otsego: 989 (Gaylord). zip-codes.com also lists 231 on the western edge (Elmira area); a sliver.
counties.Kalkaska: 231. zip-codes.com also lists 989 on the eastern edge; a sliver.
counties.Cheboygan: 231. zip-codes.com also lists 989 (the Onaway-area southeast edge) and 906 (likely a Mackinac/Bois Blanc ZIP artifact); not added.
counties.Emmet: 231. zip-codes.com also lists 906, probably an artifact of a ZIP that crosses the Straits; not added.
counties.Charlevoix: 231. zip-codes.com also lists 906, probably a ZIP artifact; not added.
counties.Washtenaw: 734 for the whole county per Wikipedia.
counties.Monroe: 734 for the whole county per Wikipedia.

OH.source: Wikipedia: List of Ohio area codes (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Ohio_area_codes); Area codes 937 and 326 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_937_and_326); Area codes 440 and 436 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_440_and_436); Area codes 614 and 380 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_614_and_380); Area codes 740 and 220 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_740_and_220); Area codes 330 and 234 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_330_and_234); Area codes 419 and 567 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Area_codes_419_and_567); WorldAtlas county lists (https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/oh/area-code-740.html, https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/oh/area-code-330.html, https://www.worldatlas.com/na/us/oh/area-code-937.html); zip-codes.com ZIP-based county lists (https://www.zip-codes.com/area-code/area-code-{216,283,330,419,440,513,567,614,740,937}.asp); plus general knowledge of rate-center boundaries. Small slivers that only the ZIP-based lists show are mentioned in notes, not added to the county's codes.

counties.Ashtabula: Wikipedia says 'almost all' of Ashtabula is 440/436. The rest is a southern sliver (330). Not included.
counties.Brown: Main code 937/326. ZIP-based data also lists 513 for the western edge (near Clermont). Treat it as a sliver; not included.
counties.Butler: Main code 513/283. ZIP-based data lists 937 for a small northern edge. Not included.
counties.Carroll: Main code 330/234. WorldAtlas lists Carroll under 740 too, probably a southern sliver. Not included.
counties.Clermont: Main code 513/283. ZIP-based data lists 937 for a small eastern edge. Not included.
counties.Clinton: Main code 937/326. ZIP-based data lists 740 for a sliver. Not included.
counties.Coshocton: Main code 740/220. WorldAtlas lists Coshocton under 330 too, probably a northern sliver. Not included.
counties.Cuyahoga: Cleveland and inner-ring suburbs are 216; outer western, southern and far-eastern suburbs (e.g. Parma, Strongsville, Westlake, Solon) are 440/436.
counties.Darke: Main code 937/326. ZIP-based data lists 419/567 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Delaware: Delaware city, Sunbury, Galena and most of the county are 740/220; southern areas near Columbus (Powell, parts of Westerville and Dublin) are 614/380. By population the 614 share is large, so consider whether 614 should be listed first.
counties.Erie: Sandusky and most of the county are 419/567; Vermilion and the eastern edge are 440/436.
counties.Fairfield: Lancaster and most of the county are 740/220; Pickerington and the NW corner next to Columbus are 614/380.
counties.Franklin: All 614/380. Wikipedia notes that some Franklin County rate centers 'primarily use 614', so a few edge exchanges may be 740. Left out.
counties.Hardin: Kenton and Ada are 419/567; the SE corner (e.g. Mount Victory) is 937/326. Wikipedia lists Hardin among the 937 counties.
counties.Holmes: Main code 330/234. ZIP data lists 419/567 for the western edge (near Ashland County). Not included.
counties.Huron: Norwalk and most of the county are 419/567; the NE corner (Wakeman area) is 440/436.
counties.Jefferson: Main code 740/220. ZIP data lists 330 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Knox: Main code 740/220. ZIP-based data lists 419/567 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Lorain: Wikipedia says 'almost all' of Lorain is 440/436. The remainder is presumably a southern-edge sliver. Not included.
counties.Madison: London and Mount Sterling are 740/220; the NE (Plain City, West Jefferson) is 614/380. Wikipedia lists Madison as part of 937, probably a small western sliver. Uncertain.
counties.Marion: Main code 740/220. ZIP-based data lists 419/567 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Medina: Main code 330/234. ZIP data lists 440 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Morrow: Main code 419/567 (Mount Gilead, Cardington). Some southern/eastern exchanges may be 740. Uncertain.
counties.Pickaway: Main code 740/220. ZIP-based data lists 614 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Portage: Main code 330/234. ZIP data lists 440 for the northern edge. Not included.
counties.Preble: Main code 937/326. ZIP-based data lists 513/283 for the southern edge. Not included.
counties.Ross: Chillicothe and most of the county are 740/220. Wikipedia lists Ross in 937, so a small western edge exchange may be 937/326. Uncertain.
counties.Scioto: Main code 740/220. Wikipedia and WorldAtlas also list Scioto under 937, probably a western-edge exchange. Not included; uncertain.
counties.Trumbull: Warren and most of the county are 330/234; the NW part (e.g. Bristolville and Mesopotamia area) is 440/436.
counties.Tuscarawas: New Philadelphia and Dover are 330/234; the south and west (Newcomerstown, Gnadenhutten area) are 740/220.
counties.Union: Marysville and most of the county are 937/326; the SE edge (Plain City, Dublin/Jerome area) is 614/380, and Richwood in the NE is 740/220.
counties.Warren: Lebanon, Mason and the southern townships are 513/283; the north (Springboro, Franklin, Waynesville) is 937/326. The split is substantial.
counties.Wayne: Main code 330/234. ZIP data lists 419/567 for the western edge. Not included.
counties.Wyandot: Main code 419/567. WorldAtlas and ZIP data also list 740 (southern edge near Marion). Not included.
